readerCopy.body: A compelling public story creates an opening to investigate the power hidden underneath the crisis. Neptune sextile Pluto can turn empathy into deeper scrutiny if someone follows the donations, contracts, images, or private decisions before attention moves on. The story becomes harder to exploit once care is linked to a record of who benefited and who carried the loss. Use the attention to ask the question the campaign would rather leave emotional. Where did the money go, and who had the authority to decide?
